summary: Implemented every stub in jwt/algorithms.py: get_default_algorithms, Algorithm.compute_hash_digest, and prepare_key/sign/verify/to_jwk/from_jwk for NoneAlgorithm, HMACAlgorithm, RSAAlgorithm, RSAPSSAlgorithm, ECAlgorithm and OKPAlgorithm, with shared key-loading and JWK-parsing helpers. The last full-suite run could not collect because jwt/utils.py (another builder's file) is still a stub; under a temporary in-process utils shim, tests/test_algorithms.py passed 77/77 and the full suite showed 224 passed and 36 failed, all outside algorithms.py (test_api_jwk, test_jwks_client, test_utils).
